Class CapabilityRequest

java.lang.Object
org.openqa.selenium.bidi.protocol.session.CapabilityRequest
@Beta @Internal public class CapabilityRequest extends Object
This is an unsupported API. No compatibility guarantees are provided. It tracks the W3C WebDriver BiDi specification directly. As the specification evolves, this API will change or be removed without prior notice.
